gen-gf-warnes-gf-sofia-sans-condensed: Loud, stretched ink strokes that taper off before they meet. Sofia Sans Condensed follows in a plain sans with big x-height and unfinished curves, so a long passage moves along easily without calligraphic shading.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-spline-sans-mono: Warnes draws bold, tapered ink strokes with generous spacing. Spline Sans Mono sits beneath it with fixed-width, code-style letters and lowercase close to the capitals, so the expressive top and the precise monospace text keep each other in check.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-strait: Warnes lays down stretched, spacious ink strokes that taper out before they ever touch, with no thick or thin. Strait answers in big round lowercase bowls.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-tiny5: Tapered ink strokes with no thick or thin, spaced out wide, mark Warnes as expressive and bold. Tiny5 carries the text as a clean sans with short-looking ascenders, and a longer passage reads in a tall, compact, approachable rhythm.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-truculenta: Warnes stretches its tapered ink strokes wide, with no thick or thin anywhere. Truculenta then packs a compact sans-serif line with tall x-height and short ascenders, so a longer passage reads tight, rounded and approachable.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-ubuntu: Tapered ink strokes that stop short of touching, spaced wide with one fixed nib, give Warnes its swagger over the lofty lowercase of Ubuntu. Modern and sturdy.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-victor-mono: Structured and precise, Victor Mono lets its bowls stay open on one side with loose spacing between glyphs. Warnes does the shouting with bold tapered strokes; Victor Mono keeps the monospace text exact.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-viga: Viga reads neutral and tidy, its capitals barely taller than the lowercase. Shrink Warnes down and its stretched, tapered ink strokes lose their drama, while a large Viga would feel heavy and hairline-free.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-voces: Expressive and bold, Warnes cuts its strokes like a fixed-width router bit, stretched and spacious. Voces does the quieter work, with tall lowercase and moderate thick-thin transitions that suit steady sans-serif reading.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-winky-rough: Warnes brings bold ink strokes that taper out, with curves that never thin at the turns. Winky Rough sits below in a sans whose lowercase nearly matches the capitals, giving the stretched heading a compact, contemporary partner.
